title: FyshHelper
description: A helper mod for the minecraft server Fysh (fysh.minehut.gg) made by its owner.
body:
# Fysh Helper

The official client-side companion mod for **Fysh**. I built it to take the busywork out of fishing on the server: tracking gemstone cooldowns, watching for bosses and lucky spots, and keeping your rod ability on a timer. Install it, join Fysh, and the helper does the rest.

Client-side only. Your friends don't need it, and it changes nothing on the server. It just reads what's already on your screen and shows it back to you in a cleaner form.

## What it does

**Gemstone ESP**
Highlights nearby amethyst gemstone clusters through walls, out to 64 blocks (adjustable). When you crack a cluster, the helper remembers the spot and starts its 20-minute recharge timer, then draws a box on the node so you can see at a glance which ones are still cooking and which are ready to mine again. It also counts how many gemstones you've pulled this session.

**Rod ability timer**
Reads the ability off your held rod, including any cooldown reduction. The moment you activate it, a countdown starts, and you get a sound when it's back up. No more guessing whether your ability is ready.

**Boss and Lucky Spot alerts**
Catches the server's "BOSS HAS APPEARED" and "LUCKY SPOT" announcements, names the boss, tracks whether it's still alive, and shows where the lucky spot is and how long until it moves. Optional sound on boss spawn so you never miss one.

**A HUD you can arrange yourself**
Eight widgets, each one you can drag anywhere on screen and toggle on or off:

- ⚔ Boss — status, last seen, next expected
- ★ Lucky Spot — location and switch timer
- ♦ Gemstones — ready vs. recharging, next ready
- ⚓ Rod Ability — ability name, ready-in countdown
- ⦿ Position — coords and facing
- ⏱ Session — playtime and gemstones this session
- ⏰ Clock — local and in-game time
- ⚡ Performance — FPS and ping

## Controls

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `M` (default) | Open the Fysh Helper menu |
| Configurable | Toggle Gemstone ESP |
| Configurable | Toggle HUD |

Everything is rebindable, and the in-game menu lets you tune ESP range, recharge timers, which boxes fill, the sound alerts, and the full HUD layout.

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- Fabric Loader **0.17.0+**
- Fabric API **0.141.0+**
- Java **21**

## Notes

Made for the Fysh community. If something parses wrong after a server update or you want a widget I haven't built yet, let me know on the Fysh Discord and I'll patch it.
